known.title: Decision 1 says that --test-concurrency runs several test() calls of one file at once, each in its own process, but Node runs one child process per test file and the tests of a file in one thread, so the single case file runs serially and misses the 5 s target
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 1 (line 25); Steps, row 2 plan_cli_parallel, Done when (line 53); Acceptance, a7 (line 66)
known.summary: Decision 1 moves the cases into one file, scripts/tests/plan-cli/cases.test.mjs, and says that `--test-concurrency` sets how many `test()` calls the runner executes at the same time, each in its own child process. The Node v24 documentation says that `--test-concurrency` is 'The maximum number of test files that the test runner CLI will execute concurrently' (https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v24.x/api/cli.html#--test-concurrency), and that each test file runs in a separate child process and 'all of those tests will be executed within a single application thread, regardless of the value of the concurrency option of test()' (https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v24.x/api/test.html#test-runner-execution-model). With one file the runner starts one child, and the cases run one after another. The Research gives 12.4 s serial, so step 2's Done when and a7 (at most 5 s on 4 cores) cannot pass. The cases must be split over several files.

known.title: Step 3's Done when and Acceptance a8 accept at most 4 gh calls per write and 2 for list, which the current helper already makes, so they pass when step 3 cuts no round trip
known.locator: Steps, row 3 plan_helper_round_trips, Done when (line 54); Acceptance, a8 (line 67); Research, gh-calls bullet (line 21); Research, Decisions, decision 7 (line 31)
known.summary: Decision 7 sets the expected counts to 3 gh calls for each write, 4 for retire, and 1 for list. Step 3's Done when accepts a logged run with at most 4 gh calls for each edit, status, step, and archive, at most 5 for retire, and at most 2 for list, and a8 accepts at most 4 per write and at most 2 for list. The Research bullet (line 21) says that the shipped plan.mjs already makes 4 gh calls for each write, 5 for retire, and 2 for list. So both checks pass on the current helper, and no check fails when the GraphQL write path of step 3 is missing or keeps the read-back call. They must require the counts of decision 7.

known.title: Step 2 adds .mjs files under scripts/tests/plan-cli/, but the validator-table walker of author-tooling.mjs requires a scripts/AGENTS.md row for each such file, and no step changes the walker or adds the rows
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 2 (line 26); Steps, row 2 plan_cli_parallel, Task and Files (line 53); Acceptance, a4 (line 63)
known.summary: Step 2 creates scripts/tests/plan-cli/cases.test.mjs and a shared harness, and it updates only the `scripts/tests/plan-cli.mjs` row of scripts/AGENTS.md. At repo_ref, validatorTableErrors in scripts/tests/author-tooling.mjs (lines 189-212) walks every folder under scripts/ except `lib` and `tests/unit`, and reports each `.mjs` file without a first-column row in the scripts/AGENTS.md table ('script missing from the scripts/AGENTS.md validator table'); scripts/AGENTS.md line 68 states the same rule. scripts/ci.mjs (lines 299-301) runs author-tooling.mjs in the gate. So the new files fail author tooling, and a4 fails. Step 2 must teach the walker to skip scripts/tests/plan-cli/ (as it skips tests/unit) or add the rows, and name the file it changes.

known.title: Step 3 has no dependency on step 2, but it edits the plan-CLI cases under scripts/tests/plan-cli/ that step 2 creates, and both steps list that folder
known.locator: Steps, row 3 plan_helper_round_trips, Depends and Files (line 54); Steps, row 2 plan_cli_parallel, Files (line 53)
known.summary: Step 3 updates the plan-CLI cases whose expected gh command or message changes, and its Files cell names scripts/tests/plan-cli/, the folder that step 2 creates when it splits scripts/tests/plan-cli.mjs. Its Depends cell is `-`, so the helper can start step 3 before step 2 (or in parallel), when the cases are still in plan-cli.mjs, which step 3 does not list. At repo_ref, plan-contract.md (Steps, acceptance, and effects, lines 72-74) says that two steps that list the same path need a Depends chain between them, or one of them must own the shared edit. Step 3 must depend on step 2.

protected.summary: Request correction: the Goal names the gate's scheduling in scripts/ci.mjs and the CI workflow, but the plan changes neither, because of decision 8 and because the workflow already runs the gate in parallel shards.
Yolo decision: overlapping gate checks in scripts/ci.mjs is rejected (it saves about 2 to 4 s and touches the timing schema, the targeting assertions, and the test-contract discovery).
Yolo decision: Node's compile cache is rejected, because it saved under 1 ms per plan.mjs start.
Yolo decision: seeding plan fixtures straight into the fake-gh state instead of running `new` is rejected, because it ties fixtures to the stub's issue format.
Yolo decision: retire keeps its close order, the pre-write read and the post-write check stay, and one updateIssue with a full labelIds list is rejected.
Yolo decision: the blocker windows become a 1000 ms block with a 300 ms child and a 1500 ms block with a 750 ms threshold; tighter values (700/300 ms) are rejected for their 1.6x margin.
